added_lemmas.justification: The proposition proves that the strict-slack condition used by the lower theorem holds on an explicit nonempty open region of the existing class constants.
added_lemmas.gap: The lower theorem is conditional on nondegenerate class constants; this proposition shows concretely that its condition is not vacuous without changing the model class or assuming the lower-bound conclusion.
added_lemmas.consumer: Readers can verify admission of the fixed-support fuzzy-hypothesis family directly from open inequalities on the existing class constants.
